ResearchProjectDef.label: beam optics
ResearchProjectDef.description: Turn electricity into a coherent beam and back again. Unlocks the beam emitter, the beam receiver and the beam mirror.

ResearchProjectDef.label: beam splitting
ResearchProjectDef.description: Half-silvered optics that split one beam into two and share the power between them. Unlocks the beam splitter.

ResearchProjectDef.label: coherent relays
ResearchProjectDef.description: Gather scattered beams, re-collimate them and fire them onward at full range. Unlocks the beam relay.
